items.titleIt: Linea guida EFP S2k sulle condizioni parodontali acute
items.titleEn: EFP S2k guideline on acute periodontal conditions
items.blurbIt: Pubblicata su JCP (settembre 2026): framework diagnostico-terapeutico per necrotizzanti, ascessi e lesioni endo-parodontali acute.
items.blurbEn: Published in JCP (September 2026): a diagnostic–therapeutic framework for necrotizing conditions, abscesses, and acute endo-periodontal lesions.

items.titleIt: Workshop AAP / Osteology Foundation / SEPA — consensus su nuove tecnologie in medicina ricostruttiva orale
items.titleEn: AAP / Osteology Foundation / SEPA workshop — consensus on new technologies in oral reconstructive medicine
items.blurbIt: Report di consensus e pacchetto di revisioni sistematiche su scaffold, biologici e approcci personalizzati (settembre 2026, Journal of Periodontology).
items.blurbEn: Consensus report and systematic-review package on scaffolds, biologics, and personalized approaches (September 2026, Journal of Periodontology).

items.titleIt: EFP ed ESC insieme sull’asse parodontite–salute cardiovascolare
items.titleEn: EFP and ESC join forces on periodontitis and cardiovascular health
items.blurbIt: Annuncio EFP di collaborazione con la European Society of Cardiology per esplorare i legami tra malattia parodontale e rischio cardiovascolare.
items.blurbEn: EFP announcement of a collaboration with the European Society of Cardiology to explore links between periodontal disease and cardiovascular risk.
